name: spillway
description: Spillway — the control plane where AI spend is governed, not just observed.
_comment_overrides: Transitive security floors. Selectors are OPEN-ENDED on purpose: a closed range like 'fast-uri@>=3.0.0 <3.1.4' stops matching the moment the lockfile reaches 3.1.4, so when the advisory floor later moved to 3.1.5 the override went inert and Ring 0 went red with 'security_update_not_possible' — the override was capping the fix it existed to deliver. Anchor the selector at the major line and put the floor in the value. brace-expansion keeps a >=4.0.0 selector because 1.x/2.x are not vulnerable and forcing 5.x on them breaks legacy minimatch.

scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d && docker compose exec postgres pg_isready -U spillway -d spillway_dev --timeout 30
scripts.gate: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:web && pnpm test:integration && pnpm migration-lint && pnpm build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm -F @spillway/shared build && pnpm -F @spillway/pricing build && pnpm -F @spillway/certifier build
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm -F web build && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.build.json
